description: The 'commits_cached' dataset provides detailed information about software project commits, capturing essential data for each commit made within a project. This dataset is particularly useful for software development teams, project managers, and data analysts who need to track changes, analyze development patterns, or assess the impact of specific commits. Each entry in the dataset corresponds to a unique commit, identified by a 'commit_id', and is associated with a specific 'project_key'. The dataset includes information about the 'author' of the commit, the 'timestamp' indicating when the commit was made, and quantitative data on the number of files and lines added, removed, or changed. This allows for a comprehensive analysis of the development process, helping to identify trends, bottlenecks, or areas for improvement. The dataset's structure supports various use cases, such as generating reports on codebase evolution, understanding team productivity, or conducting code quality assessments. By providing a granular view of each commit, this dataset serves as a valuable resource for maintaining and improving software project workflows.
shortDesc: Software project commit data with details on changes.

columns.name: project_key
columns.comment: Unique identifier for the software project.

columns.name: author
columns.comment: Name or identifier of the commit author.

columns.name: timestamp
columns.comment: Time when the commit was made, in milliseconds.

columns.name: added_files
columns.comment: Number of files added in the commit.

columns.name: added_lines
columns.comment: Number of lines added in the commit.

columns.name: removed_files
columns.comment: Number of files removed in the commit.

columns.name: removed_lines
columns.comment: Number of lines removed in the commit.

columns.name: changed_files
columns.comment: Number of files changed in the commit.
